parsed.why: No local ban, but national facilities restriction attached by legislature with arrests; national seat sits fully under hostile passport regime. Low-risk ranking offset by direct national override; no documented local protections reaching visitors.

Public-accommodations protection, hate-crime penalties, panic-defence repeal, gender-neutral single-user bathrooms, shield laws — traveler-facing. Still carries parent passport/entry regime, capping score well below Low Risk despite strongest local machinery.

Public accommodations, hate-crime coverage, accessible markers, sodomy repealed; hostility concentrated in schools/minors. Youth-targeting policies unlikely to reach adults per risk assessment, but pronoun/veto record and parental adoption refusals temper parent-regime exposure.

Adult-reaching birth-sex facilities ban in government buildings plus a state complaint form inviting reports of trans people — engineered discovery. Visitor cannot meet documentary defence; flag ban, 'leads nation' hostility deepen parent exposure.

Facilities ban extended to universities (2026), sports ban, freeze-frame prison-treatment policy, no hate-crime statute, unrepealed sodomy provision; litigation only partly blocks enforcement. Adds a hostile local layer to parent regime, slightly less than slot 4.
